content.short: Perpetual Protocol is a composable trading protocol dedicated to perpetual futures.
content.description: Perpetual Protocol is a decentralized finance protocol that offers perpetual futures trading to its users. It enables cross-margin trading on a broad range of popular tokens with up to 10x leverage, providing traders with flexible exposure across their positions. Liquidity providers contribute assets to the pool and earn trading fees from other users' activity. While no codebase is perfectly secure, Perpetual Protocol runs a bug bounty program inviting developers to report vulnerabilities in its open-source software.
